allow_large: The owner instructed the worker to commit the staged interruption repairs after the interface guard was reported. This allows the required src/forge/cli.py signal setup, shared worker handler, retry answer quoting, timeout guide, synced guide copies, regression tests and test timings.
done_when: A forge work run stopped partway prints one line saying the round did not finish and the command to run again.

known.title: Not done: A forge work run stopped partway prints one line saying the round did not finish and the command to run again.
Functional: Include the required answer in the retry instruction

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a shell time limit expires while work waits for a slow Git fetch or merge.
The handler is installed only after command dispatch, but src/forge/cli.py:143-155 calls the pin check first. That check calls prepare (src/forge/repo.py:969-971), which fetches and then merges under the item lock (src/forge/worker.py:102 and :135-136). SIGTERM or SIGINT during that preparation therefore produces no retry line; SIGTERM during the merge can also leave the lock behind. The new test waits until the SDK starts, so it does not cover this part of the work run.
findings.title: Not done: A forge work run stopped partway prints one line saying the round did not finish and the command to run again.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a worker asked a question and the answering work round is interrupted.
The message always tells the coordinator to run forge work with only the item, dropping the original --note. The pending question remains after an interrupted answer, so that command refuses instead of retrying the round; src/forge/worker.py:186-188 enforces the note, and tests/test_steer_question.py:122-157 demonstrates that the note-free retry is refused. The interruption test uses no note and therefore passes despite this incorrect instruction.
findings.title: Functional: Include the required answer in the retry instruction

stop.reason: Both findings are Harm 3: one more round by the standing rule

why: A forge work run cut short by a shell time limit leaves its lock and its builder turn unfinished and says nothing, so the lost round shows only later.
